findings_summary: All three publications are legitimate current-policy or migrated P022 observation-history replay evidence, but they are not semantic duplicates. TP2-DE338F269CA11E9BC01B isolates the q=3r-1 Franel arithmetic-core gate; TP2-D78DBA0243911E0363FA freezes the bounded forced-midpoint fallback q<6r-1; TP2-2346F5D3E731ED56DB0A attacks the surviving composite-Franel depth-cancellation escape. They therefore survive as distinct subfrontiers rather than competing theorem copies.
